# Documentation Review

## 1. Claims match the current source tree

Fail.

- `README.md` incorrectly says all state is plain JSON, although project configuration and registries use TOML and the event log uses JSONL.
- `docs/concepts/overview.md` presents an incomplete `.jit/` layout, omitting shipped files such as `index.json` and `rules.toml`.
- `web/README.md` is still the generic Vite template rather than documentation for the shipped JIT web component.

## 2. Adopter surface versus dogfood configuration

Pass.

Planning-bracket vocabulary and repository-specific gates are either identified as this repository’s configuration or presented as opt-in examples. I found no unsignalled claim that these values are `jit init` defaults.

## 3. Current behavior only

Fail.

Several documents contain migration history, past-state narration, or proposed future features instead of describing only current behavior. The literal “in-flight” occurrences also violate the supplied current-behavior rule even though they mean “not done.”

## 4. No hardcoded counts that silently rot

Fail.

The gate-preset documentation manually maintains builtin-preset and gate totals even though these values come from the builtin preset registry. The same how-to also contains an unsupported “10x faster” count.

## 5. Links and referenced paths resolve

Fail.

Seven repository-relative links/anchors do not resolve. A concrete example issue-item address also fails `jit item show`.

## 6. Content-standards conformance

Fail.

No non-Mermaid authored diagrams were found: the detected plain-text blocks are directory trees or verbatim CLI output and are allowed. No definite plain-text mathematics defect was found. Current-behavior prose violations remain content-standards failures.

## Findings

1. **F1 — Incorrect storage serialization claim.** [README.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/README.md:24) says “All state” is plain JSON, but `.jit/config.toml`, `gates.toml`, `rules.toml`, optional registries, and `events.jsonl` are not JSON. Remediation: describe the repository state as plain, diffable JSON/JSONL/TOML files rather than all JSON.
2. **F2 — Component README does not describe the shipped web component.** [web/README.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/web/README.md:1) is generic React/Vite starter text and even discusses plugins not present in `web/package.json`. Remediation: replace it with adopter-facing JIT web UI documentation matching the package scripts, runtime boundary, and actual component.
3. **F3 — Incomplete storage layout is presented as the `.jit/` mental model.** [docs/concepts/overview.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/concepts/overview.md:88) omits `index.json`, `rules.toml`, gate-run storage, and other documented parts of the current layout. Remediation: align the listing with `docs/reference/storage-format.md`, or explicitly label it as a deliberately partial illustration rather than the directory layout.
4. **F4 — Two MCP “See Also” links target absent files.** [mcp-server/README.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/mcp-server/README.md:366) links to nonexistent `docs/json-schema-api.md`, and line 367 links to nonexistent `docs/cli-and-mcp-strategy.md`. Remediation: point both entries to current documentation or remove them.
5. **F5 — Contributor quickstart link is dangling.** [docs/concepts/design-philosophy.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/concepts/design-philosophy.md:489) targets absent `CONTRIBUTOR-QUICKSTART.md`. Remediation: update it to an existing contributor document or remove it.
6. **F6 — Validation reference uses the wrong relative path.** [docs/reference/cli-commands.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/cli-commands.md:2675) targets `docs/reference/validation-rules.md`, which does not exist. Remediation: link to `../how-to/validation-rules.md`.
7. **F7 — Custom-gates anchor does not exist.** [docs/concepts/core-model.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/concepts/core-model.md:710) links to `custom-gates.md#beyond-software-development`, but that heading is absent. Remediation: target an existing heading or add the referenced section.
8. **F8 — Software-development anchor does not exist.** [docs/concepts/core-model.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/concepts/core-model.md:1218) links to `software-development.md#multi-agent-workflows`, but that heading is absent. Remediation: link to the existing multi-contributor section or add the promised heading.
9. **F9 — Concrete issue-item example is dangling.** [docs/reference/item-addresses.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/item-addresses.md:56) uses `@/issue/56ab0224/requirement/REQ-01`; `jit item show` cannot resolve it. The same fictitious address family recurs later in that reference and in the CLI reference. Remediation: use an address that exists in the live tracker, or convert the value into an unmistakable placeholder that is not presented as a resolvable citation.
10. **F10 — Planning-bracket concept contains migration narration.** [docs/concepts/planning-bracket.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/concepts/planning-bracket.md:19) says no migration is needed and that projects behave “exactly as before.” Remediation: state the current fact directly: the feature is optional configuration and projects without the configuration do not have an applicable template.
11. **F11 — Planning-bracket how-to contains migration narration.** [docs/how-to/adopt-planning-bracket.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/how-to/adopt-planning-bracket.md:26) uses “No migration needed” and “exactly as before.” Remediation: replace this with a direct statement that bracket configuration is optional and affects issues only when applied.
12. **F12 — Gate how-to narrates an old/new transition.** [docs/how-to/custom-gates.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/how-to/custom-gates.md:796) contains “Migration from Manual Setup,” “Old way,” “New way,” and “Manual approach (old).” Remediation: describe manual definitions and presets as two current alternatives without historical framing.
13. **F13 — Core-model documentation advertises unimplemented future behavior.** [docs/concepts/core-model.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/concepts/core-model.md:701) lists “Potential future enhancements (not yet implemented),” with another future-enhancement section near line 1204. Remediation: remove roadmap material from adopter documentation or move it to an appropriate planning surface.
14. **F14 — Custom-gates documentation advertises unimplemented extensions.** [docs/how-to/custom-gates.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/how-to/custom-gates.md:974) contains “Potential extensions (not yet implemented).” Remediation: remove the future-facing section and document only supported extension mechanisms.
15. **F15 — Design philosophy narrates feature history.** [docs/concepts/design-philosophy.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/concepts/design-philosophy.md:481) explains that JSON output “came from” prior agent needs and “we … added” it. Remediation: state directly that structured JSON output serves agent automation.
16. **F16 — CLI reference narrates legacy/corrupt repository history.** [docs/reference/cli-commands.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/cli-commands.md:1305) says a target “no longer exists” and cites repositories written by “an older binary.” Remediation: describe `dangling_dependency_ids` solely as the current representation of stored unresolved dependency IDs.
17. **F17 — Validation-rules how-to uses prohibited “in-flight” behavior narration.** [docs/how-to/validation-rules.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/how-to/validation-rules.md:255), repeated near line 390, describes “in-flight” issues. Remediation: state the exact current-state predicate, such as “an epic whose state is not `done`.”
18. **F18 — Validation-engine concept uses prohibited “in-flight” behavior narration.** [docs/concepts/validation-engine.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/concepts/validation-engine.md:108) describes an “in-flight epic.” Remediation: replace it with the precise configured state condition.
19. **F19 — Gate how-to hardcodes volatile preset totals.** [docs/how-to/custom-gates.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/how-to/custom-gates.md:571) manually claims eight builtin presets, and lines 581–588 and 620 repeat gate totals. Remediation: make `jit gate preset list/show` or the builtin registry authoritative and avoid prose totals; enumerate gate names without independently maintained counts.
20. **F20 — CLI reference hardcodes volatile preset totals.** [docs/reference/cli-commands.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/cli-commands.md:2360) manually claims eight builtin presets and repeats per-preset gate totals through line 2398. Remediation: cite the builtin preset registry/schema and list preset contents without hand-maintained totals.
21. **F21 — Gate how-to contains a rotting and unsupported performance count.** [docs/how-to/custom-gates.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/how-to/custom-gates.md:846) claims “10x faster: 1 command vs 10+ commands,” while the immediately preceding manual example shows four-plus commands. Remediation: replace the numeric claim with the current mechanism-level benefit: one preset application replaces repeated definitions and attachments.

Total findings: 21
